adicionar.aponte: Point the camera. Works for people on the same Wi-Fi.
adicionar.dica1_texto: "queen bohemian rhapsody" finds it faster than just the song name.
adicionar.dica2_texto: The "Preview" button plays 7 seconds from the middle to check it's the right version.
adicionar.dica3_texto: While one song is separated on the GPU, the next ones are already being prepared.
adicionar.lead: Send your own files or search a song source. The voice is separated and the song shows up ready to sing.
adicionar.sem_fontes: To search for songs elsewhere, install an add-on in Settings → Add-ons.
admin.cuidado: Don't show this code to everyone. If someone who shouldn't has access, change the code: no account stays admin (whoever should continue scans the new QR).
admin.texto: Scan with the phone of whoever will run the party: that person's account becomes an admin (on any device they sign in) and can do everything the PC can: open and close the stage on the TV, manage anyone's queue, skip, delete songs — and gets the Remote tab, a remote control with arrows, OK, back and search with the phone keyboard.
admin.trocar_confirmar: Change the code? The current admin phones lose access.
app.fechar_ocupado:
There are people in the queue or singing. Closing stops the song and the phones lose their connection.

Close IOkê anyway?
app.reiniciou: IOkê restarted its server... just a moment.
arquivo.recusado.formato: “{nome}” is not an audio or video file IOkê recognizes.
arquivo.recusado.protegido: “{nome}” is copy-protected (DRM) and can't be used.
arquivo.so_pc: Only the IOkê PC can send files.
arquivo.sumiu: this song's original file is missing from its folder: send the file again
atualizacoes.dev: Version {versao} · development mode (opened with iniciar.bat): update with Git.
atualizacoes.explica: Versions come from IOkê's releases on GitHub. The Testing channel also gets pre-release versions, before they're ready: they may have problems. Updating or going back never deletes songs, accounts, add-ons or settings (before switching, the database and settings get a copy in backups).
atualizacoes.falhou: Couldn't prepare version {versao}: {erro}. The current version keeps working.
atualizacoes.reiniciar_dica: (takes a few seconds; songs and settings stay the same)
atualizacoes.voltar_confirmar: Go back to version {versao}? Your songs, accounts and settings stay as they are.
atualizacoes.voltou: Version {versao} didn't open properly and IOkê went back to {atual} by itself.
busca.adicionada: Added! It will start downloading soon.
busca.baixando_entra: Downloading! You go on stage when it's ready.
capa.enviar_dica: click, drag a file here or paste (Ctrl+V)
capa.ultima_miniatura: The last option uses the source's thumbnail.
celular.biblioteca_vazia: The library is empty: ask the IOkê PC to add songs.
celular.buscar_dica: "Download" adds the song to the library. "Download and sing" also puts you in the queue — you go on stage when it's ready.
celular.como_aparecer: How do you want to show up in the queue and on the big screen?
celular.crie_pin_texto: 4 digits. You'll use it to sign in on another device, or if this one forgets you.
celular.esqueceu_pin: Forgot your PIN? Ask whoever runs IOkê to reset it on the PC.
celular.festa_nova: New party: queue and ranking start from zero
celular.nao_admin: This phone is no longer an admin (the code was changed on the PC).
celular.offline: No connection to IOkê. Trying again… Check that the phone is on the same Wi-Fi; if it doesn't come back, scan the QR code on the TV again.
celular.palco_livre_texto: Pick a song in "Sing" to join the queue.
celular.passar_confirmar: Pass your turn? The next people sing first and you come right back after (you stay in the queue).
celular.passar_de_confirmar: Pass {nome}'s turn? The next people sing first and {nome} comes right back after.
celular.rodizio_nota: Rotation on: everyone sings one before anyone repeats.
celular.rodizio_texto: Everyone sings one before anyone repeats
celular.sem_armazenamento: This browser doesn't keep data (private tab or cookies blocked): when you come back, sign in again with your name and PIN.
celular.sem_armazenamento_curto: This browser doesn't keep data: when you come back, sign in with your name and PIN.
celular.voce_passou: You passed your turn: you sing right after the next people.
celular.voz_guia: Guide vocals (the original vocals, low, to help)
complementos.apagar_dados: Also delete the add-on's data (login, cache)
complementos.ausente: The add-on "{nome}" is not installed (or is turned off).

complementos.indisponivel: The add-on didn't respond. Try again; if it keeps happening, check Settings → Add-ons.
complementos.instalando: Installing… (the first time can take a few minutes)
complementos.ja_instalado: Already installed (version {versao}): installing again updates it.

complementos.nenhum: No add-ons installed. Add-ons add sources of songs and lyrics. Paste an add-on's link above.

config.reiniciar_cantando: Someone is singing right now. Restart anyway? The song stops.
config.so_pc: This can only be changed on the IOkê PC

contas.pin_redefinido: {nome}'s PIN reset: let them know the new PIN.
contas_config.texto: People who joined from a phone (name + PIN). Forgot the PIN? Reset it here and tell them the new one.

controle.nenhuma_tela: No IOkê screen open on the PC

editor.texto_explica: One lyrics line per line. Empty lines are ignored; write {pausa} on a line to mark an instrumental-only part.
editor.todas_com_tempo: Every line already has a time — save, or click a line to redo it

ia.conferindo: Checking each line against what was heard...

ia.encaixando_baixando: Downloading the model that fits the words (first time only, ~1 GB) and fitting...
ia.enviando_nuvem: Sending the voice to the cloud...

ia.fazendo.rank_baixando: comparing lyrics for “{titulo}” (downloading the listening model: ~3 GB, first time only)

ia.fazendo.sincronizar_baixando: syncing “{titulo}” (downloading the listening model: ~3 GB, first time only)

ia_config.auto_ligada: The AI will sync new songs
ia_config.texto: The AI fits each word of the lyrics to the separated vocals (MMS, with Whisper as reference), with a start and an end — the karaoke highlight stops when the singer stops. The text never changes: only Fit to this version (player Lyrics menu) touches the lyrics, and only the structure (repeats, lines not sung). All local, on the graphics card.
ia_config.todas_confirmar: Sync every song that has lyrics with the AI? It takes about 15–40 s per song, one at a time, on the graphics card.
inicio.adicionar_eyebrow: From your files to the stage
inicio.adicionar_texto: Send your files or search a source. The voice is separated right away.
inicio.cantar_texto: Pick a song, dim the lights and let your voice out.
inicio.palco_titulo: Open the stage: singer queue on the TV

letra.nenhuma: No lyrics found. Try a different search.

letra.nota_tempo_dica: How many lines already start where the voice sings

midi.exemplo: E.g. if the plugin's scale has the options Major, Minor and Chromatic, use 3 options, Major = 0 and Minor = 1.
midi.texto: Create a virtual MIDI port (e.g. loopMIDI), select it in IOkê and enable it as an input in Reaper. In the autotune plugin, use Param → Learn on the Key and Scale parameters and click "Send test" so Reaper learns each CC.
midi.tom_atual: Current key: {tom} — sent when the song opens or the key changes.
midi.tom_automatico: Each song's key is sent automatically when it opens in the player.

modelo.bs_roformer_karaoke_frazer_becrui: BS-Roformer Karaoke frazer & becruily (catches choirs; may pull solo vocals)
musica.acao_indisponivel: This action isn't available right now (the add-on is off or an action is already running on this song).
musica.acao_ocupada: The song was busy and the new audio didn't go in: try again when it is ready.
musica.explica: Replace the audio uses another file of yours (better quality, for example) and separates again with the current quality. Lyrics, cover, key and settings stay as they are. The song leaves the library while it processes; if something goes wrong, the current audio stays. Redo only lead/backing separates again only the lead voice from the backing vocals, with the chosen model, on top of the voices already separated: a few minutes, the song stays in the library and the lyrics stay as they are. No model gets everything right: if in this song the choir ends up in the lead voice (or the voice leaks into the backing), try another — you can go back anytime.
musica.faixas_agora_nao: You can't change the tracks right now: wait until the song is ready.
musica.faixas_texto: Each separation is kept (up to 4). Choose where each track comes from: you can use the lead from one and the backing from another, without separating again.
musica.itunes_nada: Couldn't find this song on iTunes
musica.itunes_ok: Info filled in — check and save
musica.nome: Song name (used to search for lyrics)
musica.resplit_iniciado: Redoing the lead and backing vocals
musica.separar_confirmar: Separate this song's voice again with the current quality?
musica.trocar_audio_agora_nao: You can't replace this song's audio right now: wait until it is ready.
musica.trocar_audio_confirmar: Replace this song's audio with another file and redo the separation? Lyrics, cover, key and settings stay as they are.
musica.trocar_audio_falhou: The last audio replacement failed (the previous audio was kept):
musicas.lead: How each song is prepared when it is added.
nuvem.aviso.aceitar: Got it, separate in the cloud
nuvem.aviso.cartao: IOkê has no access to your card or your budget.
nuvem.aviso.configurei: I set the budget in Modal
nuvem.aviso.custo: Separating in the cloud uses your Modal account: each song costs about US$ 0.035 (4 min, L40S) and is charged to your card beyond the free credits.
nuvem.aviso.teto: The app's limit is US$ {teto} per month.
nuvem.chave.texto: At modal.com → Settings → API Tokens, create a key and paste both parts here. The key is stored only on this PC, protected by Windows.
nuvem.chave_invalida: The key has two parts: the token-id (starts with ak-) and the token-secret (starts with as-).
nuvem.chave_recusada: Modal rejected this key. Check both parts and try again.
nuvem.conectar.codigo: Check that the code on the page is:
nuvem.conectar.esperando: Waiting for you to authorize in the browser…
nuvem.conectar.passo1: Create the Modal account (with GitHub or Google).
nuvem.conectar.passo2: Add the card and set the budget in Usage & Billing.
nuvem.conectar.passo3: Click Authorize: the browser opens the Modal page; confirm there and come back here.
nuvem.desconectar.remover: Also delete the program and the models from the Modal account (frees ~1.5 GB there)
nuvem.desconectar.texto: The key is deleted from this PC. Songs already separated stay here.
nuvem.erro.credito: The cloud refused: the Modal account's credit or budget ran out. Check modal.com → Usage & Billing, or separate on this GPU.
nuvem.erro.desconectada: The Modal account is disconnected (or the key was deleted). Connect again in Settings → Cloud.
nuvem.erro.instalar: The job isn't installed in the Modal account. Click "Reinstall in the cloud" in Settings → Cloud.
nuvem.erro.internet: No connection to the cloud. Check the internet and click ↻.
nuvem.erro.modelo: The cloud is downloading the model (first time only). Wait a bit and click ↻.
nuvem.erro.tempo: The cloud took too long and stopped. Click ↻ to try again.
nuvem.espera.aceitar: Waiting for the cloud: accept the cost notice in Settings → Cloud.
nuvem.espera.conectar: Waiting for the cloud: connect the Modal account in Settings → Cloud.
nuvem.espera.teto: Waiting: this month's cloud limit (US$ {teto}) reached; resets on the 1st. You can separate on this GPU from the song menu.
nuvem.fila.instalando: Installing in the cloud (first time only; a few minutes)...
nuvem.gastos.erro: Couldn't read the actual spending now; the numbers may be out of date.
nuvem.gastos.nota: Modal's report arrives with a delay: the latest songs are counted by estimate.
nuvem.gpu.L4: L4: cheaper per hour, slower (~3× the time)
nuvem.gpu.L40S: L40S: fastest and cheapest per song (recommended)
nuvem.gpu.T4: T4: cheapest per hour, much slower
nuvem.instalar.modelos: downloading the models to your account (~1.5 GB)
nuvem.instalar.publicar: building the program in your account; the first time takes a few minutes
nuvem.intro: With the cloud connected, you can send songs there while this GPU works on others (☁ menu on each queued song).
nuvem.intro_leve: Light installation: this PC doesn't separate songs; they go to the cloud, in your Modal account. Connect the account to start.
nuvem.lead: Separate songs (and make AI lyrics) in your Modal account, without an NVIDIA graphics card. You pay Modal directly, per second of use.
nuvem.leve_so_nuvem: Light installation: songs are only separated in the cloud.
nuvem.login_falhou: Couldn't start connecting to Modal: {erro}. Try pasting the key manually.
nuvem.onde.leve: Light installation: cloud only. To separate on this PC, change the installation under Program.
nuvem.onde.texto: Automatic: this PC's NVIDIA card, if any; otherwise the cloud, if connected; otherwise the processor (very slow). Each song can switch with its button in the queue.
nuvem.onde_invalido: Choose: automatic, this GPU or cloud.
nuvem.qualidade_leve: Light installation: the chosen quality applies to separation in the cloud.
nuvem.remover_falhou: Couldn't delete from the Modal account: {erro}
nuvem.sem_modal: This installation doesn't have the Modal client. Update IOkê.
nuvem.sem_protecao: The key is stored without Windows protection (development mode).
nuvem.so_pc: The cloud can only be set up on the IOkê PC.
nuvem.teto.texto: The app stops sending songs to the cloud when it reaches this, on top of the budget you set in Modal.
nuvem.teto_invalido: The limit must be between US$ 1 and US$ 1000.

player.ativar_texto: Click once to allow sound. After that, whoever is up can press play on their phone.
player.clique_liberar_som: Click the screen to allow sound
player.clique_linha: Click the line being sung now · Esc cancels
player.editar_linha: Edit and sync line by line
player.endereco_mudou: The address changed: people already connected need to scan the QR code again.
player.entre_fila: Join the queue from your phone
player.fila_preparando: There's a song in the queue, but it's still being prepared. It'll be on stage soon!
player.microfone_falhou: Couldn't open the microphone ({erro}). Check the browser permission.
player.mix_guia: Karaoke with the original vocals low as a guide.
player.mix_original: Playing the original song, with vocals.
player.negativo: Negative = the lyrics show up earlier. Click the value to reset.
player.ninguem_fila: Nobody in the queue. Scan the QR code and pick a song to sing!
player.palco_aberto_fila: While the stage is open on the TV, songs go to the singer queue instead of playing here.
player.palco_aberto_texto: So the song doesn't play in two places at once, this stage waits while the one on the TV is open.
player.palco_aberto_tv: The stage is already open on the TV
player.palco_tv_fechado: TV stage closed. Freeing this one...
player.passar_explica: The next people sing first; this one comes right back after
player.passou_vez: {nome} passed the turn: back right after the next people.
player.play_celular: or press play on the phone
player.play_pelo_celular: or {nome} presses play on the phone
player.pontuacao_explica: Turns on this PC's microphone and compares your pitch with the original vocals (the octave doesn't matter). The score shows at the end of the song.
player.pontuacao_sem_melodia: This song doesn't have the vocal melody yet — it's worked out the first time (a few seconds).
player.pontuacao_valendo: It counts! Sing close to the microphone. The score shows at the end of the song.
player.processando: This song is still being processed. Come back when it shows up in the library.
player.quiosque: Kiosk mode. To close the stage: Alt+F4 on the PC keyboard, or "Close the stage" on the admin phone or in Settings.
player.sem_letra: This song doesn't have lyrics yet.
player.tela_cheia_bloqueada: Full screen blocked by the browser
player.tom_explica: Make the song lower (−) or higher (+) to sing in your key. Guide vocals and backing vocals follow.
player.usar_este: Close the TV one and use this
player.usar_este_confirmar: Close the stage on the TV and use this window as the stage?
player.visual_agora_proprio: This song now has its own look (the default for all songs is in Settings → Player)
player.visual_padrao: This song follows the default look
player.voltando_tom: Going back to the original key
player.voltar_tom: Click to go back to the original key
programa.fechar_texto: Turns IOkê off: the song stops and phones lose the connection.
programa.janela_texto: Open full screen or in a window. F11 also toggles.
programa.nada_movido: Nothing is moved or deleted: the current folder stays as is, and you can go back to it the same way. IOkê restarts to use the new folder.
programa.navegador: Opened in the browser (development mode): the window and the data folder belong to the installed app.
programa.pasta_vazia: No songs or accounts found in this folder: IOkê starts from scratch there.
programa.reiniciando_pasta: Restarting IOkê with the new folder…
programa.usar_pasta: Use this folder for the data?
qr.aponte: Point your phone camera or open:
qr.endereco_mudou: The phone address changed ({de} → {para}): people already connected need to scan the QR code again.
qr.texto: Each person adds their own songs and follows the processing. Only works for people on the same Wi-Fi as this PC.
qualidade.alta_texto: The original UVR settings, at full precision. Cleaner separation.
qualidade.equilibrada_texto: Recommended. Almost the same quality as high, at twice the speed.
qualidade.fp16: FP16 — half precision, much faster on the GPU
qualidade.maxima_texto: Processes each part 16 times. A small gain over high; use it for special songs.
qualidade.modelos_baixados: Other models are downloaded the first time they are used (0.5–1 GB each).
qualidade.overlap: Overlap: {n} — how many times each part is processed
qualidade.rapida_texto: For when the queue is long. A little voice may remain in hard parts.
qualidade.sem_gpu: No NVIDIA GPU: the CPU uses light models and these options don't apply (in the cloud, they do).
qualidade.texto: More quality = more time on the graphics card. Applies to the next songs; songs already in the library can be separated again with the {icone} button on each one.
sing.palco_aberto_aviso: The stage is open on the TV: picking a song puts it in the singer queue.
sing.vazia_texto: Add songs (your own files or from a source) and they show up here ready to sing.
tv.sair_para: If you leave now, the song that's playing stops.
visual.explica: Applies right away to all songs on "Default", on the PC and the TV. A song can have its own look: in the player, Background or Lyrics menu → Look: Own. With "Video", the preview shows the cover.
visual.lead: The default look for songs. Each song can follow it or have its own look (in the player: Background or Lyrics → Look).
visual.modo_explica: Default: follows the default look (Settings → Player). Own: just for this song.
visual.original_confirmar: Reset the default look to the original (factory) one? Songs with their own look don't change.
visual.previa3: And here comes the next one
visual.t_brightness: Opacity of the lines not being sung
visual.t_wipe: The color that fills the lyrics as they are sung
